public_rationale: December reporting identifies 2.5 percent as the best RLI completion rate, matching the original primary study. This supports Marcus’s attribution when read as describing the benchmark’s evaluated freelance projects. It does not establish a universal limit on online work. The original paper appeared in October, so the evidence supports results reported in December rather than a distinct December study.
limitations: The judgment depends on keeping the claim within the named benchmark’s scope.
December timing is established through a university’s dated summary; the primary result is from October.
Whole-project completion is different from partial assistance or success on smaller component tasks.
A stronger reading covering all online work would remain unproved.
